name: Bubble Boy
desc: The falling bubbles have to be correctly turned and placed in a matter of seconds. And if that doesn't work, you'll have to use the bomb ...

name: Continental Galaxy 2020
desc: Red alert!!!! The invaders of Minus-Delta-T approaching our solar system - and only you in your space glider can still avert the catastrophe on earth. You need a crystal clear head and nerves of steel ...

name: Dungeon Adventure
desc: In Dungeon Adventure, your character has to fight his way through the enemies on the level by collecting items (by climbing ladders).

name: Falling Block!
desc:
The new super video game from Game Master: Spatial imagination and lightning-fast reactions are required here.
9 game levels and various chicanes with increasing difficulty ensure fascinating gaming fun.

name: Go Bang
desc: The fascinating old-Asian strategy game as a video game for the game master. 3 different game levels for beginners, advanced and experts make the Game Master either an ideal practice partner or a serious opponent in this game.

name: Kung Fu Challenge
desc: The Shaolin monastery is in danger - deceitful fighters from Mandushuria are threatening to level the center of the monks to the ground. And only you are left to save the holy place: With the edge of your hand against ninja throwing stars, clubs and trident.

name: Pin Ball
desc:
With this cartridge the Game Master turns into an electronic super pinball machine: Simply tension the launch spring, let go and off you go...
And whoever scores the most points can register as a pinball champion on the current leaderboard!
The new super game with 4 levels, bonus functions and realistic pinball effects!

name: Space Castle
desc:
With a space jet against 5 intergalactic battle stars. An exciting Game Master adventure in which you have to use quick reactions and tactical skills to save the world from the attack of hostile aliens.
With bonus function and automatic point counting.

name: Tennis Master
desc:
Game, set and victory - high sporting excitement is guaranteed here: The brand new tennis cardrige for the "Game Masters" tournament ensures realistic gameplay on the LCD screen. So nothing like throwing the ball up, pressing the punch button and blasting off ...
With beginner and professional levels, referee function and score display like in real tennis!
